display_name: Qwen Image Edit 2511 GGUF — Product Ad Candidate
purpose: Generate premium product advertising candidates using Qwen Image Edit 2511 GGUF + FluxKontext. Runs the first-pass KSampler only (no SAM/LaMa inpainting). All three image slots receive the product packshot so Qwen edits it into a campaign scene.

inputs.product_image: Packshot PNG in ComfyUI/input. Used for all three image reference slots.
inputs.negative_prompt: Forbidden elements — distorted packaging, wrong colors, etc.
inputs.cfg_scale: CFG strength. Default 1.0 (CFGNorm is applied separately).

product_safety.note: Qwen uses all three image slots as visual context for the edit prompt. The product packshot is not pixel-locked — Qwen regenerates the scene. If strict pixel locking is needed, use product_locked_ad_background_v1 instead.
